description: For every node that holds an item (hasItem) or is a palace boss (isBoss), the minimal routes from startNode. A route can be taken when every requirement in its requirements list is held. Routes with more requirements than another route to the same target are left out. nodes only lists the nodes used by a route or target. Item identities are not included.
